title: Startale ERC-7579 smart accounts: re-callable initializeAccount via EIP-1153 transient flag
closed_reasons: Bug is live and unpatched (impl 0x000000b8f5...E05A byte-identical to the 2026-09-16 exploited build; fork PoC 3/3 sweeps a pre-funded account in the deployment tx).

The only value reachable is the pre-funding of a not-yet-deployed counterfactual account; measured across all 434 deployments in the last 200,000 blocks: 0.06250548 ETH total (50 accounts, max 0.002 ETH) + 11.951842 USDC (1 account) = $155.15 gross over 27.8 days.
Per-event maximum is $4.58, versus ~$0.15 gas, so steady-state net E-U is ~$0; the September $2,876 was a one-off distribution to ~330 pre-funded accounts.
A previously-deployed account cannot be re-initialized (transient flag is tx-scoped): live account reverts NotInitializable().
key_facts: impl 0x000000b8f5f723A680d3D7EE624Fe0bC84a6E05A runtime keccak 0x90713de607e95b2df2bdff40300cceb99b996db7a9b96675429a7bb15750ca67, identical at block 25,986,306 (2026-09-16) and at head
initializeAccount(bytes) selector 0x4b6a1419; TSTORE/TLOAD present; no isInitialized/owner guard
434 AccountCreated events in blocks 26,134,433-26,334,433; 11 in the last 14,400 blocks (~5.7/day)
pre-funding at creationBlock-1: 50/434 accounts, 0.06250548 ETH total, 0.002 ETH max ($4.58)
USDC/USDT pre-funding at block-1: 0/434; any-token pre-funding: 1/434 = 11.951842 USDC held pre-deployment for ~10 months
13 accounts still hold 0.01495295 ETH ($34.26); all isInitialized() == true
startale-earn/ is Startale Earn, a different contract, and was not touched
caveats: The public mempool cannot be enumerated from a standard RPC, so 'pending' value is bounded by the measured 200k-block flow rather than observed directly.
The historical $2,876 (330 accounts, USDC+USDT) is corroborated by DefiLlama and ExVul but the victim set was not independently enumerated on-chain.
The recent cohort is dominated by what appears to be protocol load-testing (0.01 USDC round-trips), so the real-user deployment rate may be lower than 5.7/day.
The attack requires winning the deployment race or acting as the bundler; capture rate is unmeasurable.
one_liner: Live unpatched ERC-7579 re-initialization (fork-proven) but the only reachable value is pre-funding of pending counterfactual accounts: $155.15 gross over 27.8 days, $4.58 max per event, so external unprivileged net extraction is ~$0 today.
